C9000212.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 212 (Planar first-passage geometry and the absence of bigeodesics.; papers: No bigeodesics in planar first-passage percolation; Strict convexity and differentiability of the planar exponential first-passage limit shape; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/212.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_CT_TRANSFER.statement: Lemma lem:cut-transfer with its actual simultaneous quantifiers: one deterministic subsequence preserves every finite upper-ray family, finite Busemann witnesses, eventual target distances and exact labels; every lower ray retains an exact-label tail at every fixed complementary cut.

C_CT_INPUTS.statement: The staged preliminary structural and uniform metric theorems have their stated minimum-moment scope, including the boundary-comparison dependency. These are explicit inputs, not results certified by the transfer audit.

C_CT_BOUNDARY.statement: The minimum-moment boundary comparison prop:boundary-uniqueness and its claimed repair of the Ahlberg--Hoffman expectation step are valid.

C_CT_SUBSEQUENCE.statement: Endpoint-uniform metric asymptotics and the identical marginal laws imply one deterministic subsequence with vanishing moving-cut normalized metric errors, independently of any selected ray or label.

C_CT_BARRIERS.statement: The opposite-semicircle norm gap, endpoint-uniform metric errors and rooted sublinear Busemann errors imply positive barriers on the entire unbounded cut, both for moving cuts with fixed witnesses and fixed cuts with sector-moving basepoints.

C_CT_LAST_CUT.statement: A finite lattice walk touching a cut has an unchanged suffix after its last cut visit; derived positive barriers exclude all improving cut-touching walks and give exact eventual target distances.

C_CT_LABELS.statement: At each retained upper cut, fixed-cut sector barriers imply exact Busemann equality along two independent lattice directions, identifying both label coordinates without a uniform label convergence rate.

C_CT_LOWER.statement: For every fixed complementary cut, the analogous upward-displacement barrier preserves an arbitrary lower-ray tail, its eventual sector target distances, and its exact original label.

C_CT_CORE.statement: Universal deterministic barrier and finite-walk transfer implications, with explicit metric and rooted-error hypotheses, including last-cut suffix localization and recovery of two linear coordinates.

C_CT_REMAINDER.statement: All remaining load-bearing claims of the no-bigeodesics manuscript and its strict-convexity companion are justified. This bounded transfer mission does not establish that assertion.
